job.title: Staff Software Engineer, Government Products
job.workplace: In the office 3 days a week
job.pay_full: $230,000 – $270,000 a year base pay (New York), plus bonus opportunities, equity and benefits

details.about: Robinhood's mission is to democratize finance for all. The company has been named brokerage and initial trustee for Trump Accounts and is working with BNY and the U.S. Department of Treasury to develop and operate the program. The Government Products team builds and scales systems for long-term investing and account management, and this engineer is a foundational technical leader for a new standalone web and app platform.
duties: Lead the design, architecture and implementation of a new standalone backend built for security, reliability and scale
Design secure data pipelines and APIs that integrate government-backed registries, employer contribution frameworks and institutional banking systems
Guide engineering teams across Robinhood's brokerage ecosystem, set code standards and mentor senior engineers
Work with Product, Security, Legal and external stakeholders on the compliance needs of a highly regulated government contract
Own backend stability and performance tuning ahead of high-volume rollouts and the public launch
needs: 8+ years of software engineering, operating as a principal or staff-level engineer on large-scale distributed systems
Mastery of high-throughput, low-latency distributed infrastructure and secure data pipelines in Python or Go
Deep expertise in domain modeling, microservices and highly reliable APIs
Execution in a zero-to-one product space
Experience as a primary technical point of contact across an organization, mentoring senior engineers
Exceptional communication with Product, Security, Compliance and external institutional partners
details.benefits: Base pay $230,000 – $270,000 a year in New York, plus bonus opportunities and equity; pay depends on factors such as education, experience, location and business needs. Robinhood offers 401(k) matching, 100% paid health insurance for employees and 90% coverage for dependents, a lifestyle wallet for wellness and learning, employer-paid life and disability insurance, fertility and mental health benefits, company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave and catered meals in the office.
notes: Based in the New York office, with in-person attendance expected 3 days a week
This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents
